items.title: TherapistTrack - Psychological Notes and Appointments Management
items.description: Development of a SaaS platform for psychologists, facilitating the management of notes and appointments with an intuitive and secure interface.
items.longDescription:
TherapistTrack is a comprehensive web platform designed specifically for psychologists and mental health professionals. The system allows managing appointments, creating session notes with customizable templates, and maintaining a secure and encrypted record of all patient information.

The project arose from the need to digitize processes that were traditionally handled on paper, providing a modern, secure, and easy-to-use solution that complies with all medical data privacy regulations.

details.challenge: Psychologists needed a secure and efficient way to digitize their patient management processes while maintaining privacy and complying with health regulations.
details.solution: We developed a SaaS platform with robust authentication, end-to-end encryption, and an intuitive interface that minimizes the learning curve.

items.title: FindCareerAI - Career Guidance Platform
items.description: Web platform that uses AI to analyze skills, interests, and labor trends, providing personalized recommendations
items.longDescription:
FindCareerAI is an innovative platform that combines artificial intelligence with labor market data analysis to help students and professionals make informed decisions about their careers.

Using advanced AI models and vector databases, the system can analyze user profiles, compare with thousands of successful professional trajectories, and provide personalized recommendations with a high level of accuracy.

details.challenge: Students and professionals needed personalized guidance based on real labor market data, not just generic personality tests.
details.solution: We implemented an AI system that combines semantic analysis of skills with labor trend data, using vector embeddings to find precise matches.
results: Processing of more than 10,000 monthly queries

items.title: Feedback Finder - Place Reviews Application
items.description: Mobile application that allows users to leave and consult reviews of restaurants, shops, and local services, with a user-centered design.
items.longDescription:
Feedback Finder is a mobile application designed to revolutionize how users discover and share experiences about local businesses. The project focused primarily on creating an exceptional user experience through exhaustive usability testing.

The design prioritizes ease of use, with intuitive flows for leaving reviews, exploring nearby places, and discovering new options based on personal preferences.

details.challenge: Existing review apps were complex and overloaded with information, making the experience difficult for casual users.
details.solution: We designed a minimalist interface with emphasis on visual experience and ease of navigation, validated through multiple rounds of testing with real users.
results: 40% reduction in time to complete tasks
60% increase in reviews left per user

items.title: TheCozyWhiskers - Coffee Shop Service Platform
items.description: Web platform for order management, inventory, and customer service in coffee shops.
items.longDescription:
TheCozyWhiskers is an integral management platform for coffee shops that unifies the order system, inventory control, and customer service in a single modern web application.

The system allows baristas to take orders quickly, manage stock in real-time, and offer an exceptional customer experience through order status notifications and an integrated loyalty system.

details.challenge: Coffee shops needed a unified system to replace multiple disconnected tools for orders, inventory, and payments.
details.solution: We developed a responsive web platform with scalable architecture, real-time synchronization, and high availability to support peak hours.

items.title: Timer App
items.description: iOS timer application with notifications and real-time synchronization
items.longDescription:
Timer App is a mobile application for iOS designed to improve productivity through time management techniques like Pomodoro. The app includes smart notifications, productivity statistics, and cloud synchronization.

The project focused on creating a smooth and energy-efficient native experience, making the most of the capabilities of the Apple ecosystem.

details.challenge: Users needed a simple but powerful time management tool that integrated natively with iOS without compromising battery performance.
details.solution: We developed a native Swift app with battery optimizations, smart local notifications, and widgets for quick access.
results: 25% increase in productivity reported by users
Battery consumption less than 2% per session
